name: Supremely
author: Supremely
description: The Supremely marketing theme. A warm, product-forward landing page for the open-source community platform.

fields.label: Accent line
fields.hint: Shown on a second line in the accent color. Leave blank for a single-line headline.

fields.label: Rotating line lead
fields.hint: Static start of the rotating line, shown under the headline (e.g. Be Supremely). Only shown when Rotating words is set.

fields.label: Rotating words
fields.hint: Comma-separated. Rendered in the accent color after the lead, cycling once and settling on the last. Include punctuation if you want it (e.g. Bold., Fast., You.).

fields.label: Subheading
fields.default: Publish updates, send newsletters, and host discussions — one simple home for your members.

fields.label: Primary button link
fields.hint: Leave blank to send visitors to sign in (members land in the community). Point it at /discussions to lead with your community as the demo.

fields.label: Closing headline
fields.default: Your community. Your data. Your rules.
fields.hint: The full-width closing statement above the final call to action.

fields.label: Closing subline
fields.default: Self-host it. Share it. Make it yours.

fields.label: Feature highlights
fields.hint: Four short highlights shown under the buttons. Each keeps its icon.

default.title: Discussions
default.desc: Connect and talk with your members

default.title: Membership
default.desc: Offer access and grow your community

fields.label: Pillars headline
fields.default: Everything your community needs. Nothing bolted on.
fields.hint: Headline above the four expanded pillar rows. Clear it to keep the headline area empty.

fields.label: Pillars
fields.hint: Four expanded rows between the highlights and the closing statement. A row with an empty title is skipped.

item_fields.label: Capabilities
item_fields.hint: One per line, up to four.

default.title: Website & Blog
default.body: A real website, not just a feed. Pages for your story, a blog for your updates, and typed content — events, recordings, resources — all under your own domain, styled by your theme.
default.points:
Pages and articles
Typed content: events, recordings, resources
Your domain, your theme

default.title: Newsletter
default.body: Turn readers into subscribers. Collect an audience with double opt-in and send issues straight from your site — the list lives in your database, not on someone else's platform.
default.points:
Subscriber management
Double opt-in
Bring your own email provider

default.title: Forum
default.body: Durable discussions, not disappearing chat. Groups, topics, and replies that stay readable and searchable, with public and members-only spaces side by side.
default.points:
Discussion groups
Public or members-only
Moderation built in

default.title: Memberships
default.body: Your community has a door, and you hold the key. Member accounts, roles, and members-only content — tease what's behind the gate to visitors, or hide it entirely.
default.points:
Member accounts and roles
Members-only content
Tease or hide gated content
